nodes.label: Select a permitted order route
nodes.semantics: The route is a policy action, never automatic routing or capital authorization.

nodes.label: Closed-bar classification flow completed
nodes.semantics: Each transition consumes only bars closed at or before the transition timestamp.

nodes.label: Follow-through is observed after a closed bar
nodes.semantics: No follow-through cannot be treated as a high-probability entry.

nodes.label: Watch point and invalidation are recorded
nodes.semantics: Watch points are observations, not hidden position-management commands.

nodes.label: Market is not extremely confused
nodes.semantics: A confused market is a terminal no-trade observation.

nodes.label: Cycle is identifiable
nodes.semantics: Cycle must be one declared regime; unknown routes to wait.

nodes.label: Reversal attempt diagnostic
nodes.semantics: Reversal is diagnostic only and never creates an inverse order without a separately admitted direction.

nodes.label: Always-In context
nodes.semantics: Always-In constrains the first plan to the prevailing direction.

nodes.label: Current direction is identified
nodes.semantics: Direction is long, short, or neutral; neutral cannot create a directional order.

nodes.label: Directional inertia exists
nodes.semantics: Absent inertia selects range or wait logic rather than trend chasing.

nodes.label: Momentum support is sufficient
nodes.semantics: Strong inertia requires low overlap, a short pullback, and consecutive directional closes near the directional extreme.

nodes.label: At least twenty quality bars are available
nodes.semantics: Insufficient or poor-quality bars route to no-trade.

nodes.label: Entry is armed and version-bound
nodes.semantics: A route may arm an entry, but the lifecycle still requires an explicit enter action before any post-entry event.

nodes.label: Failed-follow-through or weakening exit
nodes.semantics: Condition exit is only failed two-bar follow-through or confirmed weakening.

nodes.label: Confirmed continuation
nodes.semantics: Two aligned directional closes confirm; one adverse bar remains an ordinary pullback.

nodes.label: Entered lifecycle
nodes.semantics: Entry is a single policy action after all upstream gates pass.

nodes.label: Structural invalidation
nodes.semantics: First hard touch or breach immediately exits; close does not delay protection.

nodes.label: Fixed half partial exit action
nodes.semantics: No discretionary fraction, scaling, or resizing.

nodes.label: Protective stop action
nodes.semantics: Hard-touch execution uses stop price or adverse bar open.

nodes.label: Open episode at study cutoff
nodes.semantics: Right censoring is not an exit and is excluded from completed-outcome learning.

nodes.label: TP1 touch observation
nodes.semantics: First valid TP1 touch exits exactly normalized 0.5 and retains a 0.5 runner.

nodes.label: Three-bar pivot trailing action
nodes.semantics: Long max/min short ratchet is known only after the third bar and never loosens.

nodes.label: Entered but not yet confirmed
nodes.semantics: Two-bar follow-through is required; failure exits at the second close.

nodes.label: Weakened continuation
nodes.semantics: Two adverse closes plus PA context failure are required.

nodes.label: Market is readable
nodes.semantics: If the market cannot be described, wait without direction or order.

nodes.label: Ordered channel
nodes.semantics: Channel plans wait for a boundary or declared pullback signal.

nodes.label: Range boundaries are clear
nodes.semantics: Range middle is no-trade; only a boundary plan may continue.

nodes.label: Spike or fast market
nodes.semantics: Spike handling forbids chasing a climax and waits for a permitted pullback.

nodes.label: Risk distance is narrated without position sizing
nodes.semantics: The graph never emits quantity, capital, or percentage sizing.

nodes.label: TP1-based equation cross-check
nodes.semantics: Duplicate source rule is cross-checked against BD-10.3; disagreement fails closed.

nodes.label: Structural stop is explicit
nodes.semantics: No explicit stop means no entry.

nodes.label: Stop distance is acceptable
nodes.semantics: Oversized risk routes to wait or reject; it does not get a fabricated fixed stop.

nodes.label: Structural stop follows the frozen extreme rule
nodes.semantics: Stop is outside the signal or swing extreme; no fixed-size or position-sizing substitute is permitted.

nodes.label: TP1 is a fixed near structural target
nodes.semantics: TP1 participates in RR and is fixed at entry.

nodes.label: TP2 is a fixed extended structural target
nodes.semantics: TP2 is fixed at entry and is not substituted into the trader equation.

nodes.label: Trader equation passes
nodes.semantics: The equation uses TP1 only and must pass before order selection.

nodes.label: Closed signal bar has sufficient quality
nodes.semantics: An open or weak signal cannot arm an entry.

nodes.label: Signal agrees with plan direction
nodes.semantics: Misaligned signals wait or reject rather than reverse the baseline.

nodes.label: Exited trade lifecycle
nodes.semantics: Exit records one terminal reason and outcome timestamp.

nodes.label: Reject candidate
nodes.semantics: A failed gate terminates the candidate without entry.

nodes.label: Wait / no decision
nodes.semantics: No trade and no directional guess.

edges.semantics: Transition to terminal.wait when the always-in context is not established.
Transition to lifecycle.entered only after the armed entry has a bound version and causal trigger.
Transition to direction.always_in when direction in {long,short}.
Transition to regime.channel when momentum_supported=true and spike=false and channel=true.
Transition to regime.range when momentum_supported=false or (spike=false and channel=false).
Transition to regime.spike when momentum_supported=true and spike=true.
Transition to lifecycle.armed when route_permitted=true; entry remains a separate lifecycle action.
